assemblyai.name: AssemblyAI
assemblyai.description: Built for STT with speaker diarization and no file-size cap. Great for meetings with multiple speakers.

groq.name: Groq Whisper
groq.description: Very fast, faster than real time. Limited to 25MB per file, best for smaller files that need speed.

openai.name: OpenAI Whisper
openai.description: High accuracy, no free tier, priced at $0.006 per audio minute. Limited to 25MB per file.

chunking.title: Long file processing
chunking.description: Automatically split file at silent points for parallel processing and reliability.
chunking.durationHint: Default is 8 minutes. Smaller values reduce timeout risk but increase the number of requests.
chunking.macroBatchHint: The API batch should be larger than a micro-chunk. Gemini free will automatically use a safer cap to reduce request failures.
chunking.staggerHint: Default is 2 seconds. It lightly staggers parallel requests to reduce rate-limit collisions.
chunking.concurrencyHint: The production flow is locked to 1 worker to avoid RAM spikes, heat, and mobile crashes.

realtime.title: Realtime mode
realtime.note: * Realtime always uses Google Gemini, regardless of the transcript source selected above.

HYBRID.name: Hybrid (recommended)
HYBRID.description: Realtime only updates the transcript and a short summary. Decisions, risks, and action items run fully at the final step.

FULL.name: Full Realtime
FULL.description: Every chunk triggers a full AI update. More convenient, but it uses more requests.

OFF.name: Realtime off
OFF.description: No AI calls while recording. Analysis runs only once after recording stops.

BALANCED.name: Balanced
BALANCED.description: Default for most situations. Keeps voices clear with moderate noise handling.

VOICE_FOCUS.name: Voice focus
VOICE_FOCUS.description: Prioritizes voices close to the microphone. Good for meetings, interviews, or single-speaker capture.

NOISY_ENV.name: Noisy environment
NOISY_ENV.description: Stronger noise, echo, and gain processing for outdoor recording or echo-heavy rooms.

RAW.name: Raw capture
RAW.description: Disables automatic processing. Useful with external microphones or external post-processing.

CUSTOM.name: Custom
CUSTOM.description: Choose each noise, echo, gain, sample rate, and channel setting manually.

advanced.title: Advanced tuning
advanced.description: Advanced settings depend on the device hardware and microphone support.

storage.localPathDescription: Stored locally in the app. Exported or shared files are written to public folders.
